description: Source code for the PartialData class handling HTTP range requests and cache validation in Chromium's networking library.

classes.name: PartialData
classes.description: Handles HTTP range requests, cache validation, and partial data management in Chromium.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes range request parameters from HTTP headers.

methods.name: SetHeaders
methods.description: Copies request headers for later restoration.

methods.name: RestoreHeaders
methods.description: Restores headers with range information for subsequent requests.

methods.name: ShouldValidateCache
methods.description: Determines if cache validation is needed based on cache entry.

methods.name: PrepareCacheValidation
methods.description: Prepares headers for cache validation requests.

methods.name: IsCurrentRangeCached
methods.description: Checks if the current range is cached.

methods.name: IsLastRange
methods.description: Checks if the current range is the last in the sequence.

methods.name: UpdateFromStoredHeaders
methods.description: Updates internal state based on stored response headers.

methods.name: SetRangeToStartDownload
methods.description: Resets range to start download from beginning.

methods.name: IsRequestedRangeOK
methods.description: Validates if the requested range is acceptable.

methods.name: ResponseHeadersOK
methods.description: Validates server response headers for range requests.

methods.name: FixResponseHeaders
methods.description: Adjusts response headers to reflect the actual data range.

methods.name: FixContentLength
methods.description: Sets the correct content length in headers.

methods.name: GetNextRangeLen
methods.description: Calculates the length of the next data range to process.

methods.name: GetAvailableRangeCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of available range query.
